verses.text_en: And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam tisuće tisuća i deset tisuća puta deset tisuća; vidio sam mnoštvo kojemu nije bilo ni broja ni računa kako stoji pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: And on the four sides of the Lord of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel who went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.
verses.text_hr: Na četiri strane Gospodara duhova vidio sam četiri lika, različita od onih koji ne spavaju, i doznao njihova imena. Anđeo koji je išao sa mnom otkrio mi je njihova imena i pokazao mi sve što je skriveno.

verses.text_en: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before the Lord of glory.
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam glasove tih četiriju likova kako izriču hvale pred Gospodarom slave.

verses.text_en: The first voice blesses the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: Prvi glas blagoslivlja Gospodara duhova u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Drugi sam glas čuo kako blagoslivlja Izabranoga i izabrane koji ovise o Gospodaru duhova.

verses.text_en: And the third voice I heard =pray and intercede= for those who dwell on the earth and =supplicate= in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Treći sam glas čuo kako moli i zauzima se za stanovnike zemlje te usrdno preklinje u ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before the Lord of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam četvrti glas kako odbija sotone i zabranjuje im pristupiti pred Gospodara duhova da optužuju stanovnike zemlje.

verses.text_en: After that I asked the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden: ‘Who are these four presences which I have seen and whose words I have heard and written down?’
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom i pokazivao mi sve što je skriveno: „Tko su ta četiri lika koja sam vidio i čije sam riječi čuo i zapisao?“

verses.text_en: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: „Prvi je Mihael, milosrdan i strpljiv; drugi, postavljen nad svim bolestima i svim ranama sinova ljudskih, jest Rafael; treći, postavljen nad svim silama, jest Gabriel; a četvrti, postavljen nad pokajanjem koje vodi k nadi onih što baštine vječni život, zove se Fanuel.“

verses.text_en: And these are the four angels of the Lord of Spirits and the four voices I heard in those days.
verses.text_hr: To su četiri anđela Gospodara duhova i četiri glasa koja sam čuo u one dane.
